event.recordStateChanged: A record in {project} moved from {from} to {to}.
event.incidentReported: An incident was reported in {project}. Open Atlas for details.

slash.help: Commands: /xos record KEY shows a record, for example /xos record NWL-12. /xos help shows this list.
slash.unknown: That command is not one XOS knows. Type /xos help for the list.
slash.unlinked: Your chat account is not linked to XOS yet. Ask an Admin to link it in Atlas Settings, Integrations.
slash.notFound: No record {key} exists, or you cannot see it. Check the key and try again.
slash.keyMissing: Add a record key, for example /xos record NWL-12.

settings.heading: Connected services
settings.empty: No integrations are connected yet. Add one below to start syncing.
settings.readOnly: You can see this organization's integrations. Ask an Admin to connect or change them.
settings.name: Connection name
settings.nameHelp: A name your team will recognize, such as the account it connects.
settings.added: Integration added. Store its credential, then connect it.
settings.saved: Credential stored in the vault. It is never shown again.
settings.secretHelp: Paste the token or key from the service. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
settings.clientSecretHelp: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
settings.queued: Sync queued. Results appear here when it finishes.
settings.loadFailed: Integrations could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

clientCredentialHelp.ups: Create an app at developer.ups.com with the Tracking API, then copy its Client ID and Client Secret here. Atlas uses them to get a new access token each time it refreshes tracking.
clientCredentialHelp.fedex: Create a project at developer.fedex.com with the Track API, then copy its API key into Client ID and its secret key into Client secret. Atlas uses them to get a new access token each time it refreshes tracking.

errors.integration_plan_feature: Your plan does not include this service. Upgrade the plan in Billing to connect it.
errors.integration_credential_required: Store the service's credential before connecting.
errors.integration_credential_expired: That credential has expired. Get a new one from the service and store it.
errors.integration_credential_empty: Paste the credential before storing it.
errors.clientCredentialsIncomplete: Enter both the client ID and the client secret.
errors.integration_credential_too_large: That credential is too long. Check that you pasted only the token or key.
errors.integration_not_connected: Connect the integration before syncing it.
errors.integration_sync_in_progress: A sync of that kind is already running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.integration_scope_mismatch: That service cannot run this kind of sync. Choose another.
errors.integration_disconnected: This integration is disconnected. Add it again to reconnect.
errors.integration_connection_state_conflict: Someone changed this integration a moment ago. Reload the page and try again.
errors.integration_connection_transition_not_al: That change is not possible from the integration's current state.
errors.conflict: An integration for that account already exists. Use the existing one.
errors.invalid: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.denied: You no longer have access to change integrations. Ask an Admin.
errors.default: The change could not be saved. Reload the page and try again.
